answer: 证据只足以明确识别 HippoRAG 与 RoG 的核心操作，ToG 的机制描述不足。HippoRAG 的核心是构建并利用“关联图”来做知识整合：作者称“Inspired by this mechanism, HippoRAG allows LLMs to build and leverage a similar graph of associations to tackle knowledge integration tasks”[chunk_d32e1706909cc088dae124d6b0f3893c]。RoG 的核心是检索“推理路径”并做规划/推理：原文给出“# Retrieved Reasoning Paths”与“Top-K relation paths”的检索统计，并在变体比较中称“the performance of RoG w/o planning decreases significantly due to the lack of knowledge”[chunk_a3b2c707435931fa6249f247cd7d79fc]。ToG 方面，给定证据只说明它在多跳 KBQA 数据集上评测，并引用“In order to test ToG’s ability on multi-hop knowledge-intensive reasoning tasks, we evaluate ToG on five KBQA datasets (4 Multi-hop and 1 Single-hop)”，未描述其连接多跳的核心操作，故机制证据不足[chunk_deb9eea46e529705dffdd1103729c44c]。不能把“都能连接多跳知识”当作算法相同。
